text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After spending the day out together, I 
walked Mayano Top Gun back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! Today was super-duper fun! Our... 
d-a-t-e, Trainer-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I know! Come to Maya's room~! Just like in 
the TV dramas, we can have some tea 
togetherâ

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, as dorm head, I can't just 
overlook that, can I?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Aww! Papa found me~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
See, see?! In dramas, this is always how 
you bump into your dad outside the house, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, 'Dad', huh? Well, dorm heads are 
kind of like stand-in parents, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Well then... Dad, let me introduce you! 
This is Maya's special someone☆"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oho? A 'special someone' to my daughter, 
is it~? And is that really true?
choice_data_list:
...Actually, there's someone else who's 
important to me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa☆ Trainer-chan is totally blushing! 
Sooo cute!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, jokes aside. You two really do 
get along so well.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Is that why Mayano seems so full of life?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! After all, we did promise our 
futures to each other, right~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, Trainer~! Shouldn't you be saying 
'yes' right about now...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I see. Mayano really has a point.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Take good care of Mayano from now on too, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Listen to me. I sound just like a real 
father, don't I? Hehe."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll take my leave. Dinner's 
almost ready, so come along too, Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! ...Wait, before that.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We got complimented, Trainer-chan! Now 
we'll definitely nail the real thing☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Bye-bye~! See you tomorrow~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, I felt fired up to keep 
doing my best alongside Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeehhh~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What's that, what's that!? Maya didn't 
hear about this! What does that meeean!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. You seem quite good at 
having fun, don't you~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
N-No way…… Were you just playing with 
Maya's heart……!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Are you joking?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! You're right. Let's leave the 
teasing at that.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? Were both of you teasing Maya!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Jeez! That's so mean, so mean! Maya was 
suuuper sad, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph! No matter what you say, I'm nooot 
forgiving you!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"My, my, you really love it that much. It 
would be such a pity if this caused a 
falling out between you two..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Mayano, did you know about the 
cake fair they're holding in the cafeteria 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...I know, okay? Maya wanted to go too, 
but I couldn't get tickets...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It turns out I just happened to have two 
extra in my room. What do you say? Why 
don't the two of you share a cup of tea 
and make up?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaa~~!! I'll do it, I'll do it-! Maya 
wanted to go with you so badly, 
Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear that. The tickets are on the 
desk right by the door, so go ahead and 
grab them.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew... Alright, we managed somehow.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, no, the pleasure is mine. Truth be 
told, I had been hoping to give you 
something in return.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mayano is full of curiosity, after all. 
...I was worried about all sorts of 
things.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chaaan! Hurry, hurry~! The cafe's 
gonna close!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Be sure to go have fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of them enjoyed some 
tea together... and successfully made up.
